name: Morning Coffee Discount
description: Start your day with a refreshing coffee! Order any coffee before 11:00 and get a 20% discount on fresh pastries. The perfect combination for a morning mood!

name: Friday Dessert Promotion
description: Order any dessert and get a 15% discount on the second one! A great opportunity to try something new or share your favorite dessert with a friend. This offer is valid only on Fridays.

name: Dinner With Dessert
description: Order any main dish and get a dessert for free! Choose one of our popular desserts: cheesecake with strawberry or tiramisu. A great way to end your lunch or dinner!
